start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:write-product-words for a tour card on the drawing feature: you can now draw on top of any page you have open and your lines stay put when you scroll. The readers are new members."
no_lists_because: It takes the facts as input and hands the words back by where they go; it reads and writes no list.
instructions: 1. Gather every true fact about what changed or what the words are for (at least 10 characters), where the words will show (a tour card, a notice, a landing page, an email, a post) and who reads them.
2. Say "Run workflow:write-product-words" with what, and where and reader when you know them.
3. Step facts lists only what is true and the one thing the reader can now do; step draft writes every piece in full second-person sentences, leading with what the reader gets.
4. Step judge runs tool:check-copy on the words and rewrites every finding until it passes.
5. Read the final words by where they go (title, body, button) and use them; nothing was added that your facts did not state.
